_note: Sample customer conversations (input metadata only). Expected outcomes live in tests/fixtures/expected_outcomes.json and are never used at runtime.

samples.title: Double deduction + missing order confirmation
samples.text:
Customer (Aisha Khan, CUST-1001): Hi, I placed order #A-55821 yesterday for $89.99. My bank statement shows two deductions of $89.99 for that single order, so I've been charged twice. On top of that I never received an order confirmation email, so I'm not even sure the order went through.
Agent: I'm sorry about that. Could you confirm the card's last four digits?
Customer: It ends in 4417. Please refund the duplicate charge and send me the confirmation.

samples.title: Business-critical app down for multiple employees
samples.text: Raj Patel (Northwind Logistics, CUST-2040): Our dispatch portal has been down since 8:00 this morning. All 35 employees on the dispatch floor get a 503 error and cannot access any routes. We cannot schedule a single delivery right now and trucks are waiting in the yard. We need this restored immediately.

samples.title: App crashes when opening account
samples.text: Ben Ortiz (CUST-1150): Every time I open the My Account page in your Android app, the app crashes and closes. I've reinstalled it twice and restarted my phone, same thing. I can still use the website for now, but I'd like the app fixed.

samples.title: Does subscription include monthly reports?
samples.text: Chen Wei (CUST-1302): Hello! Quick question before my renewal next month - does the Pro subscription include the monthly analytics reports, or is that only in the Business plan? Thanks.

samples.title: Eligible refund not received in stated timeframe
samples.text: Fatima Noor (CUST-1410): I returned the blender from order #C-30218 and got an email on the 2nd saying my refund of $64.00 was approved and would arrive within 10 business days. It has now been over three weeks and nothing has reached my card. Can you tell me where the refund is?

samples.title: Delayed shipment needed for an event
samples.text: Daniel Brooks (CUST-1522): My order #B-77310 (the suit and two ties) was supposed to arrive on Monday but tracking hasn't updated in four days. I need it for my daughter's wedding this Saturday, which is in 3 days. Can you tell me where it is or expedite it?

samples.title: Suspicious account activity
samples.text: Grace Liu (CUST-1608): I just got an alert about a login to my account from a device in another country, and I did not make that login. When I checked my orders there is a $420 purchase I don't recognize, shipped to an address I've never used. Please lock my account and look into this.

samples.title: Cannot log in after password reset
samples.text: Omar Haddad (CUST-1733): I reset my password using the link you emailed this morning, but now every time I try to sign in it says 'invalid credentials'. I've tried the new password several times. I need to get in to download my invoices for my accountant.

samples.title: Incorrect invoice + subscription change question
samples.text: Priya Raman (Brightleaf Studio, CUST-1847): Our invoice INV-2291 for October bills us for 12 seats, but we only have 8 active users. Please correct it before it auto-pays. Separately, we're thinking about switching from monthly to annual billing - would we keep the same features, and how is the price calculated?

samples.title: Angry customer, routine feature question
samples.text: Mark Jensen (CUST-1955): THIS IS RIDICULOUS. I have spent 20 minutes clicking around your app and I am honestly furious. How do I export my contacts to a CSV file?? It should not be this hard!!!

samples.title: Late delivery with no identifying details
samples.text: Customer: hi my delivery is late. it should have been here already. where is it?

samples.title: Repeat customer: unresolved earlier problem + new billing issue
samples.text: Aisha Khan (CUST-1001): I contacted you last week because I was charged twice for order #A-55821. Nobody followed up and both deductions of $89.99 are still on my statement. Now there's a new problem: this month's bill includes a $15 late payment fee even though I paid on the due date. Please fix both.

samples.title: Shared inbox transcript with two customers
samples.text:
Shared support inbox - live chat transcript
[CUST-2101] Lena Fischer: Hi, my order #D-11902 arrived today but the phone case inside is cracked. I'd like a replacement please.
[CUST-2102] Tom Becker: Hello, what are your customer support hours on weekends?
[CUST-2101] Lena Fischer: I can send photos if that helps.

samples.title: Ambiguous request needing human review
samples.text: Ana Souza (CUST-2210): Since the last update something feels off with my account. Things aren't where they used to be and I'm not sure what changed. Can someone look into it?

samples.title: Three distinct issues in one conversation
samples.text: Hiroshi Tanaka (CUST-2305): A few things. First, order #E-40417 arrived with the wrong item - I ordered the black backpack and received a grey one. Second, my promo code SPRING20 was accepted at checkout but the 20% discount isn't on my receipt. Third, unrelated: does the backpack come with a warranty, and how long is it?
